rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for carefully checking something for faults or problems.

example.english: I inspect the pipe for leaks when I get home.
example.traditional: 我返到屋企先檢查吓個水喉有冇漏水。
example.jyutping: ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 sin1 gim2 caa4 haa5 go3 seoi2 hau4 jau5 mou5 lau6 seoi2

rows.note: Use this when an official or senior person formally examines a place, group, or facility.

example.english: The district councillor came to inspect the school premises today.
example.traditional: 區議員今日到學校視察校舍。
example.jyutping: keoi1 ji5 jyun4 gam1 jat6 dou3 hok6 haau6 si6 caat3 haau6 se3
